title: PlantX Vermicompost
description:
PlantX
Compost
Organic Soil Amendment & Natural Plant Nutrition
PlantX Compost
is a natural organic soil amendment produced through the controlled decomposition of organic materials by earthworms. It is designed to improve soil and growing media properties while providing a natural source of organic matter and plant-supporting nutrients.
Its rich organic content helps improve soil structure, water-holding capacity, aeration, and root-zone conditions, making it suitable for home gardening, ornamental plants, vegetables, herbs, and a wide range of horticultural applications.
Key Benefits
Improves soil structure and growing media quality
Increases organic matter in the root zone
Supports healthy root development
Helps improve water and nutrient retention
Enhances soil aeration and drainage
Provides a natural source of organic nutrients
Supports beneficial biological activity in the growing medium
Suitable for organic gardening and sustainable cultivation
Can be used for indoor plants, outdoor plants, vegetables, herbs, and ornamental crops
Recommended Applications
Suitable for:
Indoor Plants • Ornamental Plants • Vegetables • Herbs • Fruit Crops • Seedlings • Garden Plants • Pots & Containers • Soil & Soilless Growing Media
Application
Mix PlantX Compost thoroughly with the growing medium before planting, or apply around the root zone of established plants.
For potting mixes:
Mix according to the crop and growing-medium requirements.
For established plants:
Apply around the root zone and gently incorporate into the upper layer of the growing medium, then water thoroughly.
Application rate may vary depending on plant species, growing medium, and cultivation conditions.
Recommended Uses
Potting Mixes | Soil Improvement | Container Plants | Garden Beds | Seedling Production | Root-Zone Amendment
Note:
Product specifications and nutrient analysis should be based on laboratory testing of the final PlantX compost product.
Storage
Store in a cool, dry and well-ventilated place. Keep the product protected from excessive moisture and direct sunlight. Keep the package properly sealed when not in use. Keep out of reach of children.
Important Information
For agricultural and horticultural use
Application rates may vary according to crop and growing conditions
Do not use contaminated or improperly processed organic material
For best results, use as part of a balanced plant nutrition and growing program
Product Identification
Product Name:
PlantX Compost
Product Category:
Organic Soil Amendment
Country of Origin:
Made in Egypt
For Agricultural & Horticultural Use Only
PlantX Compost — Naturally Better Soil. Healthier Roots. Sustainable Growth.

title: PlantX Nutrient Solution for Cucumber A&B
description:
PlantX Cucumber – Hydroponic Nutrient Solution
PlantX Cucumber is a professional concentrated A+B nutrient solution specially formulated for hydroponic cucumber production. Its two-stage nutrient program is designed to match the changing nutritional requirements of the crop from early vegetative growth through flowering, fruit set, and continuous fruit production.
The formulation provides essential macro and micronutrients to support strong root establishment, vigorous vegetative growth, productive flowering, healthy fruit development, and consistent crop performance.
Key Benefits
Two-stage nutrition program for cucumber
Provides essential macro and micronutrients
Supports strong root and vegetative development
Supports healthy flowering and fruit set
Promotes balanced plant growth throughout the production cycle
Supports continuous fruit development and production
Suitable for greenhouse and hydroponic production
Concentrated and easy-to-use A+B formula
Compatible with automated fertigation systems
Two-Stage Nutrient Program
Stage 1 – Vegetative Growth & Establishment
Designed to support strong root establishment, vigorous vegetative growth, healthy foliage, and early plant development.
Usage:
From transplanting the seedling until it is 14 days old.
Stage 2 – Flowering, Fruit Development & Production
Formulated to support flowering, fruit set, continuous fruit development, and balanced plant growth during the productive stage.
Usage:
From 15 days old until the end of the season.
Recommended Crop
Cucumber
Suitable for hydroponic production using:
Dutch Bucket | Cocopeat | Rockwool | Soilless Systems | Greenhouse Production
Directions for Use
Dilute Part A and Part B separately in irrigation water according to the recommended dosage for each growth stage.
Monitor and adjust the final EC and pH according to the crop stage, environmental conditions, and irrigation water quality.
Important: Never mix Part A and Part B concentrates directly together. Add each part separately to the irrigation water while mixing thoroughly.
Suitable For
Hydroponic Cucumber Production | Greenhouses | Soilless Culture | Automated Fertigation
PlantX Cucumber — Two-Stage Nutrition for Strong Growth and Continuous Production.

title: PlantX Nutrient Solution for Strawberry A&B
description:
PlantX Hydroponics Nutrient Solution is a professional, two-stage nutrient program specifically formulated for strawberry plants at every growth phase. Our concentrated A&B formula delivers balanced nutrition tailored to your plant's changing needs, ensuring robust development from seedling to harvest.
Stage 1 (Days 1-45): Establishes a strong root system, encourages balanced vegetative growth, increases healthy leaf development, and prepares plants for flowering.
Stage 2 (Day 46+): Supports continuous flowering, improves fruit set, maximizes fruit size and quality, and sustains production throughout the season.
Each stage provides essential nutrients in precise ratios, promoting vigorous root development, optimal vegetative growth, and ultimately, exceptional flower and fruit production. Perfect for hydroponic strawberry cultivation.

title: PlantX Nutrient Solution for Flowering Ornamental Plants A&B
title_ar: محلول PlantX المغذي لنباتات الزينة المزهرة A&B
description: PlantX Flowering Ornamental Plant Nutrient Solution A&B is a complete nutrition system of two concentrated solutions, expertly formulated to nourish flowering ornamental plants with precision and stability. The dual-packet design keeps nutrients separated until use, preventing precipitation and ensuring maximum efficiency. This balanced formula delivers essential macronutrients—nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, calcium, magnesium, and sulfur—alongside vital micronutrients including iron, manganese, zinc, boron, copper, and molybdenum. Together, they support vigorous blooming, vibrant foliage, and sustained plant health. Ideal for a wide range of ornamental varieties, this concentrated solution is economical and easy to use. Simply shake both packets, add solution A to water first, then solution B. Never premix the concentrates.

title: PlantX Nutrient Solution for Indoor Ornamental Plants and Shade Plants A&B
title_ar: محلول PlantX المغذي للنباتات الداخلية ونباتات الظل A&B
description:
PlantX Indoor Plant Nutrient Solution A&B is a complete nutrition system of two concentrated solutions specially developed to meet the nutritional needs of indoor plants, ornamental plants and shade plants. The formula contains a balanced blend of macro and micro nutrients needed to support the natural growth of the plant, maintain leaf vitality, and promote the healthy appearance of plants grown indoors, office or indoor gardens. The A&B system adopts the separation of certain nutrients within two independent packets to help maintain the stability of the solution and prevent precipitation of elements before use, ensuring higher efficiency when preparing the irrigation solution at the recommended dosage.
Features
✔ Balanced nutritional formula for indoor plants and ornamental plants.
✔ Contains macroelements: nitrogen (N) phosphorus (P) potassium (K) calcium (Ca) magnesium (Mg) sulfur (S)
✔ Contains micro elements: iron (Fe) manganese (Mn) zinc (Zn) boron (B) copper (Cu) molybdenum (Mo)
✔ Helps support normal vegetative growth.
✔ Contributes to the preservation of green color and vitality of the leaves.
✔ Suitable for regular use with most houseplants.
✔ Concentrated and economical formula.
Suitable for
Pothos, Monstera, Snake Plant, ZZ Plant, Ficus, Dracaena, Philodendron, Aglaonema, and most indoor ornamental plants and shade plants.
How to Use
Shake the two packs well before use. Add the required amount of A to the water first and stir. Then add the required amount of B to the same water. Do not mix the two concentrated solutions together before diluting with water. Use the solution after dilution at the recommended dosage.
Storage
Store in a cool and dry place away from direct sunlight, sealed after use, and out of reach of children.

description: PlantX Hydroponics Nutrient Solution is a scientifically integrated and balanced formula, specifically designed to meet the nutritional needs of herbs, medicinal and aromatic plants in hydroponic systems, in particular the NFT system.
